jess (design): Quick sync — I prototyped a compact onboarding stepper for first-run. Main things to decide: persistent help affordance (tiny '?' icon) vs hover-only tooltips, how the progress indicator should announce changes for screen readers, and sample-project card layout (single column vs two-column). Thoughts? omar (product): +1 to making the help persistent. Hover-only fails on touch and for keyboard users. :eyes: Also we should standardize the microcopy for finished steps — 'Completed' vs 'Done' vs 'Set up'. sasha (devex): Persistent '?' sounds good. If it's a button we need clear aria attributes and keyboard focus styling. Also thinking about dismiss state — store in localStorage or user preferences? liam (eng): LocalStorage is simplest for the initial rollout, we can wire to user prefs later. Implementation note: make the popover non-modal (no focus trap) but focus moves to the popover when opened and Escape closes it. aria (a11y): Agree with non-modal. Important: announce progress updates with aria-live polite on the step counter. Use aria-controls on the help button and aria-expanded toggles. Example snippet: ```html
...content...
Step 2 of 4
``` aria (a11y): Also, make sure the progress meter has a visible text equivalent, not just color. Contrast: the blue badge on light-grey fails AAA for small text at current swatch — we should use darker blue or bolder text. jess (design): Good catch on contrast. I'll re-swatch. For the microcopy, my vote is 'Completed' — reads more consistent in sentences: "Step 1: Model added — Completed". omar (product): +1 'Completed'. Also sample-project cards: product team leans two-column on desktop to show more options, but collapse to single column on mobile. We need to define breakpoints. liam (eng): Proposed breakpoint: two-column >= 960px, one-column < 960px. Cards should be keyboard-focusable and have clear focus outline. CSS hint: ```css .card:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (min-width: 960px) { .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; } } ``` sasha (devex): If we go two-column, make sure sample project selection updates preview region with aria-live so screen reader users see the change. Use role="region" and aria-labelledby on preview. aria (a11y): Also check tab order: skip the help popover or ensure it doesn't steal tab focus when dismissed. Add a "skip to console" link for keyboard-first users on first-run. jess (design): Decision proposal: 1) persistent '?' icon that opens a dismissible popover (aria controls/expanded), 2) progress area with role=status and aria-live polite, 3) two-column sample cards on >=960px collapses to single column on mobile, 4) microcopy use 'Completed'. Anyone object? omar (product): +1 liam (eng): +1, will prototype the markup and share a quick branch. aria (a11y): +1, will run the accessibility checklist and list contrast hex suggestions. sasha (devex): I'll add localStorage dismiss and telemetry for help opens (event: quickstart.help_open). deploy-bot: Deployed design tokens PR #412 to staging for contrast experiment (link: https://staging.redwood.ai/pulls/412) :rocket: jess (design): Awesome — thanks all. I'll update the figma with the new swatches and microcopy, and ping again once Liam has the branch. :thumbsup:
